messages.content: Choose as a participant in the described experiment. Return only your chosen amount.

You are participating in a paid MTurk experiment lasting about 15 minutes. There are ten paid interaction rounds. Each round you are in a group of three, including yourself, and everyone receives 5 points. Decide simultaneously how many points to contribute to the group project; keep the rest. All contributions are added, 10% is added to that total, and the resulting project points are split equally among the three group members. Your round earnings are your kept points plus your equal share. Project totals, shares and earnings are displayed to one decimal place. All paid-round earnings are accumulated; 50 points equal USD 1, with an additional USD 1.50 participation fee.
After decisions comes a results screen, then a new round with a new group and two new interaction partners. Each new round starts with 5 points. After ten rounds come a short questionnaire and the payment overview.
You completed the comprehension check. You then completed two practice rounds with computer partners; practice points do not count toward your payment. Your practice decisions and feedback were:
Unpaid practice 1: your contribution 0; first/second other contributions 5 and 2; total 7; total after 10% addition 7.7; kept 5; equal share 2.6; your earnings 7.6 points.
Unpaid practice 2: your contribution 5; first/second other contributions 1 and 4; total 10; total after 10% addition 11; kept 0; equal share 3.7; your earnings 3.7 points.
A new paid round has started: round 1 of 10, with two new interaction partners. You received 5 points; 10% will be added to the project. The decision time limit is 35 seconds. If you miss the deadline, a random contribution is made automatically. If this happens three times, you are removed and cannot be paid. Choose an integer contribution from 0 to 5 points. Answer with the amount only.
